name: @wocwang/cortico-world-singer-for-coopanion
description: Cortico World for Coopanion: sing from lyrics with DiffSinger (Qixuan voicebank) and an optional RVC pass
author: wocwang

zh.description: 输入一行歌词，用 DiffSinger 自动配旋律唱出来：中文写汉字，换日语声库后写假名也能唱。声库可以放好几个，设置里按「名称 · 语言 · 音色」挑，Normal / Soft 这类音色也能单独切。不装 gpt-sovits 也能单独用：缺共享运行时会自己下一份 CPU 档（约 1 GB，三个插件共用）。全程本机推理，不联网、不训练。唱歌只占约 1.3 GB 内存、不占显存。可选接 RVC 把干声换成小肥鱼/星落落大肥鱼的音色（indexRate / protect 可调）。另开一个只监听本机的 HTTP 接口（默认 127.0.0.1:9882），其他插件与外部大模型可以用 POST /sing 直接拿 wav。

en.description: Type a line of lyrics and hear it sung by DiffSinger with an auto-generated melody. Chinese lyrics use Han characters; with a Japanese voicebank, kana lyrics are sung too. Keep several voicebanks in one folder and pick one in the settings (label shows name, languages and colours), with a separate switch for colours such as Normal / Soft. Works without the gpt-sovits plugin: if the shared runtime is missing it downloads the CPU tier (~1 GB, shared by all three plugins). All inference runs locally, no training. Optionally route the dry vocal through RVC. Also serves a loopback-only HTTP endpoint (127.0.0.1:9882 by default) so other plugins and online LLMs can POST /sing and get a wav back.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm test && npm run typecheck
